select src.id , src.rule_name as ruleName , src.rule_name_short as ruleNameShort , src.strategy_product_json as strategyProductJson , src.base_info as baseInfo , src.exec_type as execType , src.cycle_day as cycleDay , src.cycle_end_day as cycleEndDay , src.task_type as taskType , src.product_info as productInfo , src.is_online as isOnline , src.priority as priority , src.check_status as checkStatus , bmc.cid , group_concat(bmc.api_code) as api_code , case src.status when 1 then '开启' when 2 then '禁用' when 3 then '开启中' else '-' end as status , DATE_FORMAT(src.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime , DATE_FORMAT(src.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime , bcr.id as crId from b_score_rule_config src left join b_customer_rule bcr on src.id = bcr.rule_id left join b_marketing_customer bmc on bcr.customer_id = bmc.id
src.is_del=1
and (src.rule_name like CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') or src.rule_name_short like CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') or bmc.cid like CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') or bmc.api_code like CONCAT('%',#{search},'%'))
and src.status=#{status}
and
date_format(src.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= str_to_date(#{cts},'%Y-%m-%d')
and
date_format(src.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= str_to_date(#{cte},'%Y-%m-%d')
and
date_format(src.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= str_to_date(#{uts},'%Y-%m-%d')
and
date_format(src.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= str_to_date(#{ute},'%Y-%m-%d')
and src.exec_type=#{execType}
group by bcr.rule_id order by src.update_time desc, src.create_time desc

select src.id , src.rule_name as ruleName , src.rule_name_short as ruleNameShort , src.strategy_id as strategyId , src.priority as priority , bmc.cid , bmc.api_code as apiCode , bcr.id as crId from b_score_rule_config src left join b_customer_rule bcr on src.id = bcr.rule_id left join b_marketing_customer bmc on bcr.customer_id = bmc.id
src.is_del=1 and src.status=1
and bmc.api_code in
#{item}

src.is_del=1 and bcr.is_del = 1 and bmc.status = 1
and src.id in
#{ruleId}

#{item}
